statement: A tree is determined up to isomorphism by the spectrum of its adjacency matrix.
definitions: Trees are finite, simple, unlabelled. The spectrum of a tree is the multiset of eigenvalues of its 0/1 adjacency matrix, equivalently its characteristic polynomial. A counterexample is a pair of non-isomorphic trees with the same characteristic polynomial (for trees this equals the matching polynomial sum_k (-1)^k m_k x^{n-2k}), together with a verification of cospectrality and of non-isomorphism (e.g. differing degree sequences).
